package rulefixtures

import (
	"strings"
)

// scenario for string_builder_write_string_vs_plus: `builder.WriteString(a + b)` where `a` and `b` are separate bindings
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

func scenario644Positive(firstName, lastName, title string) string {
	var builder strings.Builder
	builder.WriteString("User: ")
	builder.WriteString(firstName + " " + lastName)
	builder.WriteString(", Title: ")
	builder.WriteString(title)
	return builder.String()
}
